content.user_title: Plan Free Marketing Tools That Generate Leads
content.value_statement: Free marketing tools can create demand, but weak ideas waste engineering time. This skill helps plan useful tools with clear audiences, SEO paths, lead capture, and ROI checks.
actual_capabilities: Classifies free tool ideas such as calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, libraries, and educational tools.
Evaluates audience fit, search demand, lead quality, build feasibility, and maintenance burden.
Plans lead capture options, including gated, partially gated, optional capture, and ungated flows.
Compares custom builds, no-code tools, and embedded third-party options.
Creates a structured strategy document with concept, SEO opportunity, build plan, metrics, and timeline.
Projects tool ROI using estimated leads, conversion rate, customer value, build cost, and maintenance cost.
limitations: It does not perform live keyword research or fetch search volume data.
It does not build the tool unless paired with separate implementation work.
It cannot guarantee leads, rankings, backlinks, or revenue outcomes.
It depends on accurate business, audience, budget, and technical capacity inputs.

use_cases.title: Plan a Lead Magnet Tool
use_cases.description: Define a free calculator or generator that attracts qualified buyers and supports sales follow-up.

use_cases.title: Evaluate SEO Tool Ideas
use_cases.description: Compare tool concepts by search intent, link potential, uniqueness, and maintenance effort.

use_cases.title: Scope an MVP Build
use_cases.description: Turn a selected concept into a focused build plan with core features, capture flow, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Tool Type
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first free tool.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a free marketing tool type for my business. My product is [product], my audience is [audience], and my goal is [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Score Tool Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare several candidate ideas before building.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these free tool ideas with the scorecard in this skill: [ideas]. Focus on audience fit, SEO opportunity, lead quality, uniqueness, and build feasibility.

prompt_templates.title: Design Lead Capture
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan conversion without reducing tool usage too much.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lead capture strategy for this free tool: [tool concept]. Recommend gating level, capture fields, follow-up, and user experience tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for implementation and promotion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete free tool strategy for [business]. Include concept, target audience, SEO opportunity, build approach, lead capture, metrics, promotion, ROI, and timeline.

output_examples.input: A SaaS company wants a free tool to attract operations leaders.
output_examples.output: Recommended concept: an operations cost calculator. The strategy explains the target audience, inputs, output report, partial gating, SEO keywords, and follow-up path.

output_examples.input: A marketing agency has four possible tool ideas and limited development time.
output_examples.output: The skill ranks each idea by demand, buyer fit, uniqueness, feasibility, and share potential. It recommends the strongest MVP and what to skip initially.

output_examples.input: A developer tools company wants organic traffic and product education.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes an interactive validator with crawlable content, supporting articles, optional email capture, product links, and measurable launch goals.

best_practices: Start with a real audience pain point before choosing a tool format.
Keep the first version focused on one valuable workflow with clear output.
Measure traffic, completions, lead quality, influenced pipeline, and maintenance cost.
anti_patterns: Do not gate the entire tool when reach and sharing matter more than direct capture.
Do not build a complex product clone before validating search demand and buyer fit.
Do not measure only traffic when the business goal is qualified leads or revenue.

faq.question: What kind of tools does this skill help plan?
faq.answer: It helps plan calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resource libraries, quizzes, simulators, and educational tools.

faq.question: Can it help decide whether to build or use no-code?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares custom builds, no-code tools, and embedded options based on strategic value, speed, cost, and maintenance.

faq.question: Does it perform real SEO research?
faq.answer: No. It frames keyword strategy and SEO checks, but separate research tools are needed for live volume and competition data.

faq.question: Can it create a lead capture plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend full gating, partial gating, optional capture, or ungated use based on the tool goal.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides strategy prompts and planning structure that can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code sessions.

faq.question: Will it build the finished marketing tool?
faq.answer: No. It creates the strategy and scope. Implementation requires separate design, development, testing, and launch work.
